precepts.why:
Ezekiel goes on in chapter 10. “And there appeared in the cherubims the form of a man’s hand under their wings.” The cherubims are another group of angels.

“Behold the four wheels by the cherubims”: there’s that term wheels, the four wheels by the cherubims, by the angels. “One wheel by one cherub, and another wheel by another cherub”: each cherub had a wheel beside it. “And the appearance of the wheels was as the colour of a beryl stone”, a green stone. “As if a wheel had been in the midst of a wheel.”

“They turned not as they went”: they did not turn as they went, “but to the place whither the head looked they followed it”, whichever way the head looked.

“And their whole body, and their backs, and their hands, and their wings, and the wheels, were full of eyes round about, even the wheels that they four had.” Just eyes. That’s what you people think, that you can hide your sin from God. You cannot hide. How you going to hide from that? Eyes everywhere: I see you.
